# OSHO_GLOBAL_UPLOAD_MIN_INTERVAL_V1
                    # OSHO_GLOBAL_UPLOAD_MIN_INTERVAL_V2
                    # Serialize automated uploads and enforce a global
                    # 29-minute minimum interval using durable public
                    # YouTube receipts as the source of truth. Fail closed
                    # if the authoritative receipt store is unavailable.
                    import fcntl as _fcntl
                    import time as _time

                    _yt_state = Path(
                        os.environ.get(
                            "OSHO_YOUTUBE_STATE_DIR",
                            "/data/youtube",
                        )
                    )
                    _yt_receipts = _yt_state / "receipts"
                    if not _yt_receipts.is_dir():
                        raise RuntimeError(
                            "YouTube receipt store unavailable; "
                            "refusing upload without spacing evidence: "
                            f"{_yt_receipts}"
                        )
